description:
Your brand, your sound. Insta360 Mic Pro is now available in Arctic White.
 
A clean white body, a customizable E-Ink display you control from the Insta360 app, and the same pro audio underneath.

• 3-mic array with 32GB storage
• AI noise canceling powered by an NPU chip
• 32-bit float internal recording
• Direct Connect to Insta360 X6, X5, X4 Air, Luna Ultra, Ace Pro 2, and GO Ultra, no receiver needed
• Up to 400m of wireless range and 30 hours of use
• Auto Gain Control for perfect volume control
